requirement: v2.2.5: the packed artifact mounts and boots in DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 (host entries active, all w2m_* tools registered, browser half composed and activated, real page boots, composer menus usable), and package.json#engines.dsh declares the supported host range before any plugin code loads

assertions.host: DSH 0.2.2-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.2 installed from npm; cordis 4.1.0, cordis-plugin-loader 1.1.0, cordis-plugin-group 1.1.0 resolved by that tree)
assertions.loader: drive the packed 2.2.5 artifact through the real Loader in a web profile: 177 entries active, 0 failed fibers, the w2m row active, 23 tools registered through the tools service projection
assertions.client_host_half: the real clientModules registry accepted the package's dsh.client declaration and composed a boot-graph row for @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin from the shipped lib/client.js
assertions.client_activation: the real client module system plus a real Cordis fiber activated the entry (state active, no error) and it took 16 composer/sidebar/settings seats
assertions.client_page: the profile's Web app booted in headless Edge against the real server: the package stylesheet arrived, the boot overlay was dismissed, and no entry reported a boot failure
assertions.composer_control: the Node-execution menu opened from the composer with three options, and selecting temporary execution updated the control to 'Node-execution: temporary 24h, 24h left' with data-on=true and no error note
assertions.routes: w2m_status reports target_selection.attached=true and the live connection registry holds 25 fetch routes, including /api/w2m/target, /api/w2m/capability and the four /api/w2m/remote/* routes
assertions.engines_dsh: package.json#engines.dsh is '>=0.2.0 <0.3.0'; DSH evaluates it with includePrerelease, so 0.2.2-rc.1 and 0.2.2-rc.2 both satisfy it, and the packed tarball installed into the rc.2 profile without a compatibility refusal
assertions.compat_gate: compat.yml pins DSH_HOST_VERSION 0.2.2-rc.2 with cordis 4.1.0 / cordis-plugin-loader 1.1.0 / pnpm 11.28.5; the pin is the release gate's measurement of this host
assertions.not_adopted: rc.2 lets a plugin register MCP servers through ctx.mcpManager; this package does not, because its bundled w2m-mcp server mirrors the same w2m_* tools for codex and Claude hosts, so mounting it inside DSH would register every tool twice
assertions.artifact: scripts/pack.mjs packs dist/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-2.2.5.tgz deterministically from this tree; the published sha256 is the one release.yml writes into dist/SHA256SUMS beside the tarball, so the artifact digest is not restated here -- a record that named its own tarball's hash would be inside the tarball it describes
assertions.scope: code, tests, manifests and docs; the probe profile and the rc.2 runtime live under a temporary directory, and publishing is a separate workflow run
